title: Volume and Projection Inequalities II: Determinants and $L_p$-Sums
summary: We study inequalities for the volume of orthogonal projections and their relation to Firey $L_p$-sum, together with their determinant-power analogues, motivated by the Dembo--Cover--Thomas conjecture. For $L_p$-zonoids $K,L\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ and $u\in S^{n-1}$, we consider the inequality \[ \left( \frac{|K\oplus_p L|} {|P_{u^\perp}(K\oplus_p L)|} \right)^p \geq \left( \frac{|K|}{|P_{u^\perp}K|} \right)^p + \left( \frac{|L|}{|P_{u^\perp}L|} \right)^p . \] For every $1<p<2$, we prove that this inequality fails in every dimension $n\geq2$.
